Target: arm64-apple-macosx26.0
cold_definition: Ten fresh service/helper openings per entry. Model verification/reopen occurs outside the timed edit; OS file/shader caches may be warm.
corpus: Controlled load: 1 real model document embedding plus repeated orthogonal constructed noise in two files. Production real noncached query embeddings, native composer and real permission worker. This is not a representative million-document quality corpus.
measurement_boundary: Committed NSTextView input to validated publication, and to forced layout/display plus rendered accessibility observation. No compositor/GPU presentation fence.

initial_build_cancelled.reason: Dependency resolution stopped before compilation to avoid overlapping benchmark CPU load.

orchestration_pause.reason: Pause the size-loop owner only; current 10k Swift test child continues. Build/coverage will run after this child exits, then the loop resumes. Command wall includes the explicit pause.

query_cache_warmup: Round zero is cache fill; reuse has 99 samples at 10k/100k and 19 at 1m. The first aborted 1m attempt used 100 warm rounds and retains its partial rows.
compiler_difference: Measured host Swift 6.4; repository pins 6.3.1. No Swift 6.3.1 run was performed.
override_scope: Controlled temporary fixture roots only. Actual metadata child revalidates each file. Policy gates and revocation have separate focused tests; these timings are not thermal/low-power policy validation.
